scope: Development override only; actual nominal core module and textual part in a dependency-free crate preserving the declared physical path. Not immutable provider adoption, a full-workspace pass, or lifecycle acceptance.

harness_input_error.repair: Use the public check CLI-supported --output-format json option.

command_harness:
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

source = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
checker = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3])
rustc = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[4])
original = source.joinpath("crates/molten-core/src/nominal.rs").read_text()
config = source.joinpath("dylint.toml").read_text()
records = []


def replace_once(text, before, after):
    assert text.count(before) == 1, (before, text.count(before))
    return text.replace(before, after, 1)


variants = {"positive": original}
variants["raw-field"] = replace_once(original, "pub holder: PrincipalRef,", "pub holder: String,")
alias = replace_once(original, "macro_rules! domains {", """macro_rules! domains {
    (@alias PrincipalRef, $family:ident, $marker:ident) => { String };
    (@alias $alias:ident, $family:ident, $marker:ident) => { $family<$marker> };""")
alias = replace_once(alias, "pub type $alias = $family<$marker>;", "pub type $alias = domains!(@alias $alias, $family, $marker);")
variants["raw-alias"] = replace_once(alias, "AdmittedReference::Principal(PrincipalRef::new(value)?)", "AdmittedReference::Principal(String::from(value))")

for name, content in variants.items():
    fixture = root / name
    member = fixture / "crates/molten-core/src/nominal.rs"
    member.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    member.write_text(content)
    parts = pathlib.Path("crates/molten-core/src/parts/nominal")
    shutil.copytree(source / parts, fixture / parts, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    (fixture / "dylint.toml").write_text(config)
    (fixture / "Cargo.toml").write_text('''[package]
name = "molten-nominal-smoke"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
[lib]
path = "crates/molten-core/src/nominal.rs"
[workspace]
[workspace.metadata.octet]
default_scope = ["-p", "molten-nominal-smoke"]
cargo_check_args = ["--lib", "--offline"]
''')
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment.update(CARGO_HOME=str(fixture / ".cargo-home"), CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(fixture / "target"))
    for variable in ["RUSTC_WRAPPER", "RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER", "DYLINT_LIBS"]:
        environment.pop(variable, None)
    locked = subprocess.run([str(rustc.with_name("cargo")), "generate-lockfile", "--offline"], cwd=fixture, env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if locked.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(locked.stderr)
    if name != "positive" and not (fixture / "plain").exists():
        plain_output = fixture / "plain"
        plain_output.mkdir()
        argv = [str(rustc), "--crate-name", "nominal_smoke", "--edition=2024", "--crate-type=lib", str(member), "--out-dir", str(plain_output)]
        completed = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=fixture, env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
        records.append({"case": name, "phase": "plain-rustc", "command": argv, "exit_code": completed.returncode, "stdout": completed.stdout, "stderr": completed.stderr})
    artifacts = fixture / "artifacts"
    argv = [str(checker), "check", "--output-format", "json", "--artifact-dir", str(artifacts), "--", "--lib", "--offline"]
    completed = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=fixture, env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
    result_file = artifacts / "results.jsonl"
    findings = [json.loads(line) for line in result_file.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()] if result_file.exists() else []
    status_file = artifacts / "status.json"
    status = json.loads(status_file.read_text()) if status_file.exists() else None
    records.append({"case": name, "phase": "public-cargo-octet", "command": argv, "exit_code": completed.returncode, "findings": findings, "status": status, "stdout": completed.stdout, "stderr": completed.stderr})
print(json.dumps({"cases": records}, indent=2))
